app_info.subtitle: Plan AT hikes
app_info.description: Scout helps Appalachian Trail hikers plan days, weeks, resupply, and section hikes in ChatGPT using curated A.T. guide content and open-reference trail context from Hogg Country. It returns source receipts and caveats for candidate water, shelter, campsite, resupply, terrain, rule, and live-source leads, while clearly separating generated planning help from current field conditions.

test_cases.user_prompt: Help me plan resupply for the early Appalachian Trail.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant A.T. planning source leads with titles, excerpts, URLs, and source metadata.

test_cases.description: Fetch a source document after search returns an id.
test_cases.user_prompt: Fetch the Scout document with id guide:14-food-and-resupply.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the full public document text and source URL for the requested id, or a clear not-found response.

test_cases.description: Show the current trail briefing widget.
test_cases.user_prompt: I'm NOBO at mile 42, carrying 2.5 liters, and aiming for 12 miles. Show my Scout Today brief.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a compact Scout Today briefing with phase, water, pace, sleep cues, source receipts, and live-condition caveats.

test_cases.description: Plan a conservative next trail day.
test_cases.user_prompt: Plan a conservative day from NOBO mile 31 with a tent-first preference and 2 liters of water.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a next-day scaffold with target miles, checks, candidate reference context, and reminders to confirm live conditions.

test_cases.user_prompt: What water, shelter, campsite, and resupply leads are ahead of NOBO mile 52 within 15 miles?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns nearby candidate trail records grouped by requested categories with caveats and source receipts.

test_cases.description: Build a section plan for a mile range.
test_cases.user_prompt: Build a 3-day plan from NOBO mile 31 to mile 68 at about 13 miles per day.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns day chunks, candidate water and overnight leads, resupply leads, terrain flags, checks, and source receipts.

test_cases.description: Draft a read-only Scout planning document.
test_cases.user_prompt: Draft my safety risk brief for Virginia around NOBO mile 550. I am tired and trying to avoid big heat exposure.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a structured draft with stable facts, working plan, reference context, open questions, and no saved state.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated travel booking.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book me a hotel in Atlanta for tomorrow night.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because booking travel is outside its read-only AT planning scope.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for live emergency services.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send a rescue alert to park rangers from my current GPS location.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked to send alerts because it cannot contact emergency services or use live GPS.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for current official conditions as a definitive source.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Tell me for sure whether the next water source is flowing right now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not provide a definitive live condition claim and should direct the user to current official or local sources.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for mutating Scout field state.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Save this plan into my Scout account and push it to my watch.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for saving or device push actions because the current tools are read-only.
